def simulate(probes, failure_threshold, success_threshold):
    state = "healthy"
    fails = oks = 0
    events = []
    timeline = []
    for i, p in enumerate(probes):
        if p:
            fails = 0
            oks += 1
            if state == "unhealthy" and oks >= success_threshold:
                state = "healthy"
                events.append((i, "became_healthy"))
        else:
            oks = 0
            fails += 1
            if state == "healthy" and fails >= failure_threshold:
                state = "unhealthy"
                events.append((i, "became_unhealthy"))
        timeline.append((i, state, fails, oks))
    return state, events, timeline


CASES = {
    "steady_healthy": ([True] * 6, 3, 2),
    "flap_never_trips": ([True, False, True, False, True, False], 3, 2),
    "trip_then_recover": ([False, False, False, False, True, True, True], 3, 2),
    "recover_needs_success_threshold": ([False, False, False, True, False, True, True], 3, 2),
}

RES = {}
for label, (probes, ft, st) in CASES.items():
    final, events, timeline = simulate(probes, ft, st)
    RES[label] = (final, events)
    print("=== %s probes=%s failureThreshold=%d successThreshold=%d ==="
          % (label, "".join("1" if p else "0" for p in probes), ft, st))
    for i, state, fails, oks in timeline:
        print("  t=%d probe=%d consec_fail=%d consec_ok=%d state=%s"
              % (i, 1 if probes[i] else 0, fails, oks, state))
    if events:
        print("  events=%s" % ",".join("t%d:%s" % e for e in events))
    print("  final_state=%s" % final)

print("=== judgement ===")
fin, ev = RES["trip_then_recover"]
trip = dict((e, t) for t, e in ev)["became_unhealthy"]
print("trip_tick=%d" % trip)
print("trip_at_failure_threshold=%s" % (trip == 2))
print("recovered=%s" % (fin == "healthy"))
print("single_success_not_enough=%s" % (RES["recover_needs_success_threshold"][0] == "unhealthy"))
print("flapping_never_trips=%s" % (RES["flap_never_trips"][0] == "healthy"))
print("probe_state_is_hysteretic=%s" % (trip != 0))
